departments.name: Cardiology

departments.name: Neurology & Neurosurgery
departments.description: Expert neurological care for strokes, chronic migraines, epilepsy, neuropathy, Parkinson's disease, and spine rehabilitation.

departments.name: Orthopedics & Joint Replacement
departments.description: Specialized orthopedic surgical and non-surgical care for fractures, sports injuries, joint replacement (knee, hip), arthroscopy, and arthritis management.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Child Care
departments.description: Compassionate pediatric and neonatal healthcare, developmental assessments, newborn vaccination drives, and pediatric intensive care (NICU/PICU).

departments.name: Dermatology & Skin Health
departments.description: Clinical and cosmetic dermatology treating acne, eczema, psoriasis, hair loss, skin allergies, and laser-assisted dermatological procedures.

departments.name: General & Internal Medicine
departments.description: Primary healthcare and acute chronic illness management including fevers, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, infectious diseases, and executive wellness health checkups.

departments.name: Gastroenterology & Hepatology
departments.description: Advanced care for gastrointestinal reflux (GERD), liver disorders, pancreatitis, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and diagnostic endoscopy & colonoscopy.

departments.name: Pulmonology & Respiratory Medicine
departments.description: Diagnostic and therapeutic pulmonary care for asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), pneumonia, sleep apnea, and post-viral pulmonary rehabilitation.

lab_tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with ESR
lab_tests.description: Evaluates overall health and detects anemia, infections, leukemia, and inflammation markers.

lab_tests.name: Comprehensive Lipid Profile
lab_tests.description: Measures Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, and Triglycerides to assess cardiovascular risk. Requires 10-12 hours fasting.

lab_tests.name: HbA1c (Glycosylated Hemoglobin)
lab_tests.description: Assesses 3-month average blood glucose level for diabetes diagnosis and tracking.

lab_tests.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)
lab_tests.description: Records electrical activity of the heart to diagnose arrhythmias, ischemia, or heart strain.

lab_tests.name: 2D Echocardiography with Color Doppler
lab_tests.description: Ultrasound evaluation of heart valves, ejection fraction, and myocardial wall motion.

lab_tests.name: MRI Brain & Cervical Spine
lab_tests.description: High-resolution imaging for stroke, tumors, nerve impingement, or multiple sclerosis.

lab_tests.name: Digital Chest X-Ray (PA View)
lab_tests.description: Checks lungs, airways, and cardiac silhouette for pneumonia, bronchitis, or effusion.

lab_tests.name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
lab_tests.description: Evaluates Bilirubin, SGOT/AST, SGPT/ALT, Alkaline Phosphatase, and Albumin for hepatic health.

lab_tests.name: Thyroid Profile (Total T3, T4, TSH)
lab_tests.description: Screens for hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism metabolic disorders.

lab_tests.name: Vitamin D3 & Vitamin B12 Duo
lab_tests.description: Checks essential bone and nerve health vitamins for fatigue, bone aches, or tingling sensation.

hospital_protocols: EMERGENCY PROTOCOL (Red Code): Immediate triage for acute chest pain radiating to left arm, sudden facial drooping/speech loss (Stroke FAST protocol), severe breathless distress, or trauma. Proceed straight to Ground Floor Emergency Room (ER) or call Ambulance Hotline Ext: 108 / 102. No appointment required.

VISITING HOURS: General Inpatient Wards: 04:00 PM to 07:00 PM daily (Maximum 2 visitors per patient). Intensive Care Units (ICU/CCU/NICU): 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 05:00 PM to 06:00 PM (1 immediate family visitor only).

INSURANCE & CASHLESS TPA: Cashless hospitalization is facilitated on Ground Floor TPA Desk. Network partners include Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Care Health, Max Bupa/Niva Bupa, and Paramount TPA. Requires pre-authorization 48 hours before planned admission or within 24 hours of emergency admission.

LABORATORY FASTING RULES: Tests requiring 10-12 hours overnight water-only fasting include: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS), Lipid Profile, and Liver Function Test (LFT). Do not consume tea, coffee, milk, or breakfast before morning blood collection.
APPOINTMENT CANCELLATION & RESCHEDULING: Patients can cancel or reschedule appointments online or via the AI Assistant up to 2 hours before the scheduled time slot without penalty.
